Unhinged description: Labelled FREE SAMPLE. Slightly warm. It looks at things when you are not looking at it, and it is judging.
Effect: Eat it: reveals the layout of one room.

Unhinged description: Spins counterclockwise out of spite. The smoothie setting has never once been used for smoothies.
Effect: ATK +3. 10% chance to blend an enemy's morale.

Unhinged description: Each jar holds a smaller jar. The smallest jar holds an opinion about your life choices.
Effect: +2 inventory slots.

Unhinged description: Chewy. Stamped with a tiny signature. Do not read the signature.
Effect: Heal 8 HP.

Unhinged description: Shows up after everyone has left and stabs the aftermath. Extremely apologetic about it.
Effect: ATK +2. Always acts last, but crits 25%.

Unhinged description: Not a hat. A hostile takeover. Each hat in it thinks it is the boss hat.
Effect: DEF +3. Each hat absorbs 2 damage, then falls off.

Unhinged description: They remember your mother's face when you said 'I'm fine.' They sigh for you.
Effect: DEF +2, SPD +1. Sighs reduce enemy morale.

Unhinged description: Do not open indoors. Do not open outdoors. Open it where it hurts the most, and mean it.
Effect: Lights the room. Heals you in the dark, hurts undead.

Unhinged description: The wax forms a shape. You pretend it looks like a duck. It looks like a duck with a lawyer.
Effect: The blob takes the silhouette of the next boss.

Unhinged description: Someone has chewed out every verb. You can still tell it is a threat.
Effect: Sells for 2 gold. Reading it costs a turn.

Unhinged description: Has been ringing since before the dungeon opened. Answer it and someone sighs, 'Finally.'
Effect: Once per floor, answer for a random ally NPC.

Unhinged description: You light it and something stops being there. You are never sure what, until you need it.
Effect: Burn a noun: remove one object from a room.

Unhinged description: A second shadow, folded. Wear it and enemies hit the wrong one. The shadow resents this and files complaints.
Effect: Enemies attack the wrong target 25% of the time.

Unhinged description: A tiny sink, running. Chaos in a small, wet, porcelain package.
Effect: Places a puddle that slows enemies.

Unhinged description: Slightly cursed. Not enough to matter, just enough that you do not want to be holding it at midnight.
Effect: Does nothing. Suitable for gifting.

Unhinged description: A small porcelain mouth on a handle. It bites. It whispers 'more'. It is nearly always right.
Effect: ATK +6. Bleeds. Each hit pushes Temper +1 toward Fed.

Unhinged description: Warm. Hums. Sews itself into things you did not ask it to.
Effect: Crafting part for several modules.

Unhinged description: Seasoning by the day. Add it to anything and anything starts to taste like a rumor.
Effect: Restores stamina. Your dreams get worse.

Unhinged description: Your car is somewhere. So are you, just later.
Effect: Forces a boss to park for 2 turns.

Unhinged description: Seventy-two years overdue. The fine is now larger than the dungeon.
Effect: Stuns the Overdue Librarian Wraith.

Unhinged description: Strictly decorative. Strictly not edible. The pudding disagrees.
Effect: Immune to Lunch Lady attacks while held.

Item: Receipt for a Refund That Has Not Happened Yet
Unhinged description: Dated tomorrow. Signed by yesterday.
Effect: Removes a boss's buffs once.

Unhinged description: A faded elastic. Smells like someone who did the right thing and paid for it.
Effect: Temper -1 each floor you carry it.

Unhinged description: A tally clicker that clicks by itself. It is counting something. You do not want to be the something.
Effect: Shows Wholeness and how much the Mother stirs.

Unhinged description: Two halves held together with wax. Do not make a wish. They both heard you.
Effect: ATK +5. Splits in two when it crits.

Unhinged description: Fits any hole. Any. Including that one. Yes, that one.
Effect: Plugs a hole or drain for the rest of the floor.

Unhinged description: Reads VIP ALL ACCESS in crayon. It works. That is the scariest part.
Effect: Guards ask fewer questions.

Unhinged description: Might be a keyring. Might be a dentist. Do not ask the dentist.
Effect: Sells for 1 gold. Occasionally hums.

Unhinged description: Warm like a hand on your back that you are not sure belongs to a person.
Effect: Quakes shake you 20% less.

Unhinged description: Not a weapon. A tool for undoing. Echo goes quiet whenever you hold it.
Effect: ATK +4. Removes one enemy buff per hit.
